description: Toilettes publiques dans le réseau RATP is a dataset listed in Île-de-France Mobilités open data, an open data portal of a public transport authority, published or maintained by Île-de-France Mobilités. Le présent jeu de données est une reprise des données publiées sur l'Open Data RATP. Ces données ne seront accessibles que sur l'Open Data d'Île-de-France Mobilités et sur le portail PRIM à partir de septembre. Coverage: France (network area of the operator or portal owner). It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal files it under Arrêts, Lignes. Its keywords are RATP, Chercheur ou journaliste. The portal shows 2023-12-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence ODbL Version Française (https://doc.transport.data.gouv.fr/le-point-d-acces-national/cadre-juridique/conditions-dutilisation-des-donnees/licence-odbl). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-idfm-open-data-portal.
